page.overview:
Who is Apple Stars?

Apple Stars is a female unicorn pony with a purple coat, green mane and tail, magenta eyes, and a cutie mark of two green apples. She is unnamed in the show, but she is named in merchandise and other media.

Apple Stars shares her design and eye color with Lemon Hearts, Lilac Hearts, and S04E24 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #3, shares her design with Twinkleshine, Sunshine Petals, Cipher Splash, S04E12 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #4, "Cloverbelle", S05E12 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #3, S05E02 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #1, S06E04 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #1, "Nook", S06E08 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #1, "Precious", S06E04 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #2, "Rosewood Brook", and S06E14 Unnamed Earth Mare #2, shares her mane and tail style and eye color with "Golden Glory" and S05E24 Unnamed Earth Mare #2, shares her mane style and eye color with Maple Apple, shares her mane and tail style with S02E05 Unnamed Unicorn Mare #1, "Ocean Breeze", and S04E24 Unnamed Earth Mare #4, and shares her tail style with Daisy, Strawberry Sunrise, Caramel Apple, Golden Harvest, Blueberry Curls, Spring Forward, Lucky Star, "Serena", S01E03 Unnamed Earth Mare #3, S04E08 Unnamed Earth Mare #2, "Lilac Blossom", "Mint Swirl", "Apple Top", S04E24 Unnamed Earth Mare #1, S05E12 Unnamed Earth Mare #2, "Maroon Carrot", S01E11 Unnamed Earth Mare #4, S01E11 Unnamed Earth Mare #5, S04E12 Unnamed Earth Mare #3, S04E22 Unnamed Earth Mare #19, S04E12 Unnamed Earth Mare #1, "Berry Icicle", S04E22 Unnamed Earth Mare #10, S02E11 Unnamed Earth Mare #6, S04E22 Unnamed Earth Mare #14, "Cornflower", "Soft Spot", "Bell Perin", Pizza Pie, [https://apps.facebook.com/ponyscopes/ Virgo], and normally "Ivy Vine".

Apple Stars shares her mystery pack production name with G3 Earth pony mare Green Apple.

In the season two episode A Friend in Deed, Apple Stars and Earth pony "Princess Erroria" open a Ponyville window and sing in the choir of the Smile Song.
